values.note: Each year's reservations open on one date (2027: April 1 at 8 a.m.), online or through the camp host. Stays capped at 30 days in any 60 for RVs (tents 3 nights in 14); three-night minimum over Memorial Day, Labor Day and a weekend Independence Day. No electrical converters or pigtails allowed.

booking.source: https://www.smithvillemo.org/departments/parks_and_recreation/campground.php ('2027 Reservations: Open April 1, 2027 at 8:00 AM', 'Reserve A Site', 'call camp host', 'Maximum length of stay is 30-days in any 60-consecutive day period', 'The minimum stay for a recognized holiday is three (3) nights ... Recognized holidays are Memorial Day, Labor Day, and Independence Day when it falls on a weekend', 'The maximum length of stay for tents is three (3) nights in any 14-day period') + Premier page ('NO ELECTRICAL CONVERTERS OR PIGTAILS OF ANY KIND ARE ALLOWED'), read 2026-11-07

note: City of Smithville campground at the back of Smith's Fork Park below the Smithville Lake dam, gravel pads in loops among scattered trees beside the ballfields; camp hosts at site 1. Closed for Nehemiah Fest in mid-September. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40 full-service base (20/30/50A, water, sewer); added showers/flush/laundry, season Apr 1-Oct 31, city Premier booking, 30-in-60 max, 3-night holiday minimum. Not waterfront kept (below the dam). Pin ~200 m S of the campground in a field: move flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the campground is below the Smithville Lake dam (the city page: 'tucked away in the back of beautiful Smith's Fork Park below the Smithville Lake dam'), so no lake value; the Little Platte River below the dam is ~250 m+ off on NHD, and the only channel at the campground's north edge is a few-metre dry ditch between the north loop and the ballfields on leaf-off imagery.
